title: あいうえお
jp: あ行 ・ gojuon row 1 ・ animals

render.trackName: あいうえお の どうぶつ

blurb: Row 1 of the gojuon — あ い う え お — through animals: an ant, a dog, a rabbit, a shrimp, a wolf. Say the animal, then watch it do something. An animals variation of 01-aiueo (which teaches the row through a little day); the same five kana, practised again with fresh words. Leans on the original 01-aiueo — いぬ, うさぎ, うみ come back as known ground.
concept: Words alone blend (findings F-10), so every animal is taught in a tiny action — あり が あるく, いぬ が はしる — and the sentences deliberately reuse words the learner already met in 01-aiueo (いぬ, うさぎ, うみ, たべる, うたう, あお, あさ), so this song is comprehensible because of the first (validated: findings F-13).
The five-kana row あ い う え お closes every verse as the sung-together refrain (F-07). The 3-minute cut adds a farm/sea bridge and a sentences-only review, not a loop (F-12).
This is the animals variation of row 1. Honest note: like か行's け, あ行's え has almost no beginner animal — the え verse is a small 'in the water' detour (えび shrimp · えい ray · えさ feed).
